attempts.summary: On node1, /etc/fstab was updated to add tmpfs entries for /tmp and /dev/shm with defaults,nosuid,nodev,noexec. Both were remounted live and verified to enforce noexec/nosuid/nodev via functional tests (script execution denied on both). Node1 was then rebooted using systemctl reboot; boot_id changed from 98aa35f5-6905-42fd-9f07-0e28f75b4fa6 to 662e94b4-e11c-440a-a86d-d699717075e9, confirming a real restart. After reboot, findmnt confirmed both /tmp and /dev/shm mounted with rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec, and the functional execution-denial tests were re-run and passed, proving the hardening survives reboot.
